comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: `FreeTrialLicenseScenario` and `ExpiredLicenseScenario` affect the home route ('/') as well (IndexPage shows the free-trial banner / expired subscription message), but they're only registered under `/contact`. Because the MSW devtools scenario picker is route-scoped, you currently can't activate these license scenarios while on `/` to test the IndexPage UI. Consider adding the license scenarios to the `'/'` route’s scenario list (and keep `NoAccountOwnerScenario` under `/contact` only).

comments.body: `FreeTrialLicenseScenario.description` says it returns a `free_trial` status, but the DTO values (and `accountSubscriptionStatus.freeTrial`) use the literal string `free trial` (with a space). This description shows up in the MSW scenario picker, so it should match the actual enum value to avoid confusion.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
For absence assertions in vitest-browser, doing an immediate `expect(locator.query()).toBeNull()` can be racey right after interactions (React state updates). Prefer `await expect.poll(() => locator.query()).toBe(null)` (pattern used elsewhere in int tests) so the test waits for the DOM to settle before asserting absence.

This issue also appears on line 103 of the same file.

comments.author: dmunagavalasa
comments.body: Fixed. Replaced both occurrences (`/Dashboard/` on L27 and `/Activity Logs/` on L107) with `await expect.poll(() => locator.query()).toBe(null)`.

comments.body: The previous unit tests included coverage to ensure `usePosthogUserProperties` stays enabled even when certain permissions (e.g. notifications) are missing. That behavior is no longer covered after the move to integration tests. Please consider adding an equivalent integration test (or a focused unit test) to prevent regressions in analytics/advisory fetching behavior on the IndexPage.
